C0996.title: Thai esports player sentenced for Arena of Valor cheating: 3 months jail
keywords: Thai esports player sentenced for Arena of Valor cheating: 3 months jail
C0996.summary: On December 15, 2025, Thai esports player Tokyogurl used remote software to let her boyfriend play on her behalf during the 33rd Southeast Asian Games Arena of Valor (RoV in Thailand) competition. On March 17, 2026, Bangkoks Pathum Wan District Court sentenced her to 3 months imprisonment (halved for pleading guilty) under Thailands Cybersecurity Act and Computer Crime Act. Her team Talon Esports terminated her contract, and publisher Garena imposed a lifetime ban. The act damaged esports fairness and national reputation.

references.title: Thai esports players Tokyogurl, Cheerio get 3 months detention for cheating at SEA Games - VnExpress International
